verdict.rationale: Kintsugi has no documented export or offboarding feature. Its CSV file upload and migration guide cover bringing data in, not taking it out. Some data can be pulled programmatically through read endpoints, such as listing all nexuses and paginated filings, via the REST API and SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec. So leaving is possible only as a piecemeal, build-it-yourself API extraction. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, export of transactions, customers and exemption certificates, explicit open-format downloads (CSV/JSON) from the app, an offboarding guide, and independent corroboration.
